freeze_attestation: This contract was written after the result-before treatment freeze but before the FY2024 annual-report body was opened. It uses only the already-frozen bridge's operating-cash and cash-capex leg; no FY2024 value, narrative, result direction, market datum, valuation, or later issuer material informed the contract.
outcome_window: FY2024 official full annual report only
material_question: Did the disclosed consolidated cash carrier support treating capacity-driven growth as current normal owner cash, or did cash capital absorption remain unresolved or adverse?

responsibility_boundary.required: consolidated Flat Glass Group cash-flow statement
responsibility_boundary.why_this_is_the_permitted_local_carrier: The frozen application did not assert that group cash proves product economics. It named same-boundary operating cash and cash capital expenditure as a required bridge leg. This contract settles only that company-level cash leg and leaves customer absorption, utilization, realized price or spread, funding/recoverability, and product-level economics outside its authority.
prohibited_substitutes: cash balance, financing inflow, or group liquidity
depreciation, accrual capex, disposal proceeds, acquisition spending, or a maintenance-versus-growth-capex estimate
a parent-company statement or an unaudited summary
